Title: Owner email displays on Project Details page
Preconditions: Owner is logged in, valid project with owner email exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to /projects/:id | 2. Verify Owner Email stat card is visible | 3. Verify email value matches project owner's email
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card displays with label "OWNER EMAIL" and value shows the actual owner email address

Title: Complete flow from project creation to owner email visibility
Preconditions: Owner account exists with valid email, user is logged in as owner
Steps: 1. Navigate to /post-job | 2. Fill all required fields (title, description, budget, skills, deadline) | 3. Submit form | 4. Navigate to newly created project detail page | 5. Scroll to metadata stat cards | 6. Verify Owner Email card displays
Test Data: title="Test Project", description="Test desc", budget=1000, skills="React", deadline=future date, owner email from auth context
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card appears in the detail page grid showing the logged-in owner's email address

Title: Owner email fallback when email is missing
Preconditions: Project exists but ownerId.email is null or undefined
Steps: 1. Open project detail page with project that has no owner email | 2. Locate Owner Email stat card | 3. Verify fallback display
Test Data: Project record where ownerId.email is null/undefined
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card displays with em dash ("—") as the value

Title: Owner email field follows Oktawave branding
Preconditions: Valid project with owner email, desktop browser
Steps: 1. Navigate to project detail page | 2. Inspect Owner Email stat card styles | 3. Verify gradient background (#f8fafc to #f1f5f9) | 4. Verify border color (rgba(15,23,42,0.06)) | 5. Verify label uppercase 10px font #94a3b8 | 6. Verify value 14px font #1e293b | 7. Hover over card and verify border changes to rgba(45,181,218,0.22)
Test Data: Any project with valid owner email
Expected Result: Owner Email card matches existing stat card visual pattern: gradient background, proper spacing (14px 16px padding), rounded corners (12px), hover effect with Oktawave primary color accent

Title: Owner email card is keyboard accessible
Preconditions: Project detail page loaded, keyboard navigation enabled
Steps: 1. Use Tab key to navigate through page elements | 2. Verify Owner Email stat card can receive focus during tab order | 3. Verify focus indicator is visible | 4. Test with screen reader to confirm label and value are announced correctly
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card participates in natural tab flow, shows visible focus outline, screen reader announces "Owner Email" label followed by email value

Title: Owner email displays correctly on mobile viewport
Preconditions: Valid project with owner email, mobile device or viewport < 720px
Steps: 1. Open project detail page on mobile or resize browser to mobile width | 2. Verify stat grid reflows to single or dual column | 3. Verify Owner Email card maintains readability | 4. Verify text wrapping (word-break) works for long emails
Expected Result: Owner Email card adapts to narrow viewport without horizontal overflow, text wraps properly using word-break style, maintains padding and visual hierarchy

Title: Owner email with special characters
Steps: 1. Create/view project where owner email has special chars | 2. Navigate to detail page | 3. Verify email renders completely without truncation or encoding issues
Expected Result: Full email address displays correctly in Owner Email stat card without HTML encoding or truncation

Title: Backend fails to populate ownerId
Preconditions: API response contains unpopulated ownerId (string ID instead of object)
Steps: 1. Mock or simulate API returning project with ownerId as string "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011" | 2. Load project detail page | 3. Verify app does not crash | 4. Verify Owner Email shows fallback
Test Data: API returns {ownerId: "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011", ...} instead of {ownerId: {_id: "...", name: "...", email: "..."}}
Expected Result: Page renders without error, Owner Email stat card shows "—" fallback, no console errors

Title: Extremely long email address
Preconditions: Owner email exceeds typical length (>50 chars)
Steps: 1. View project where owner has very long email | 2. Check Owner Email stat card rendering | 3. Verify no layout breaking | 4. Verify card expands vertically if needed
Expected Result: Email wraps to multiple lines within stat card boundary due to word-break:break-word, card height adjusts, no horizontal overflow or grid breaking

Title: Project detail page with missing ownerId entirely
Preconditions: Project record exists but has no ownerId field at all
Steps: 1. Access project detail page for project with null ownerId | 2. Verify page renders | 3. Verify Owner Email stat card shows fallback
Test Data: Project document {_id, title, description, ownerId: null}
Expected Result: Page loads without crash, Owner Email displays "—", Posted by also shows fallback "—"

Title: Owner email maintains consistency with other stat cards
Preconditions: Multiple projects with various states, grid has 5+ stat cards visible
Steps: 1. Navigate to project detail page with all metadata populated | 2. Compare Owner Email card with Budget, Deadline, Posted by, Listed on, Last updated cards | 3. Verify visual alignment, spacing, and typography match | 4. Verify grid layout remains balanced
Expected Result: Owner Email integrates seamlessly into existing grid, maintains same height/padding as siblings, no visual misalignment or style inconsistency

Title: Owner email updates when navigating between projects
Preconditions: Multiple projects exist with different owners/emails
Steps: 1. View project A detail page, note Owner Email | 2. Navigate to project B detail page | 3. Verify Owner Email updates to project B's owner email | 4. Navigate back to project A | 5. Verify Owner Email reverts to project A's owner email
Test Data: Project A owner="owner1@example.com", Project B owner="owner2@example.com"
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card value correctly updates on each navigation, no stale data from previous project

Title: Network error when fetching project
Steps: 1. Mock network failure or disconnect | 2. Attempt to load project detail page | 3. Verify error state handling | 4. Verify Owner Email card is not rendered in error state
Test Data: Network timeout or 500 error from backend
Expected Result: Project detail page shows error message "Project not found" or loading state, Owner Email stat card is not rendered during error state, app does not crash

Title: Owner email visibility across user roles
Preconditions: Both owner and bidder accounts exist, same project
Steps: 1. Log in as owner, create project, view detail page, note Owner Email is visible | 2. Log out, log in as bidder | 3. Navigate to same project detail page | 4. Verify Owner Email is visible to bidder as well
Test Data: Owner account with email "owner@test.com", Bidder account, shared project ID
Expected Result: Owner Email stat card is visible to all authenticated users viewing the project detail page (no role-based hiding), displays same email value regardless of viewer role

Title: Owner email supports RTL and internationalized email addresses
Steps: 1. Use project with owner email containing unicode domain or local-part | 2. Navigate to detail page | 3. Verify email renders correctly without mojibake | 4. Verify browser handles IDN properly
Test Data: Owner email with unicode like "用户@例え.jp" or "testü@mÜller.de"
Expected Result: Email displays correctly without character corruption, browser may punycode-encode domain for display, no layout issues
